entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [iOS] Navigation bar TitleView isn't rendered within the device's bounds. #31688
  • Device identifiers #31687
  • [Testing] Include more testing around Windows Image Aspect recent fixes #31686
    .NET 10 Planning

Closed

  • [iOS] SafeArea doesn't properly account for how much of a view is under the soft input #31191
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • Images loaded into CollectionView items via ImageSource.FromResource at runtime are not visible and break the layout #13904
  • System.ArgumentException: Expected 4 values for property AndroidRule::AndroidPackageFormat, but got 2. #31700

  • error 404 _framework/blazor.web.js in maui-blazor-web #31589
  • Text-To-Speech unable to override system's default voices #26853
    Backlog
  • [iOS] AppThemeBinding in CollectionView2 not updating consistently #31554
  • Talkback is currently announcing incorrect information. When a list item is selected or deselected, it announces the details of the previous item instead of the current one: A11y_.NET 9 template_Projects screen_Talkback. #30833
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • On applying Resize (Larger Text) "Work, Personal, Health, family and Friends" list items are getting truncated in Home Screen: A11y_.NET 9 template_Home_Resize #30830
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • On applying Resize (Larger Text) "Save button" is getting truncated in Task Screen: A11y_.NET 9 template_Task_Resize #30829
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • [CV] Footer is displayed at the top if ItemsSource is set at a later point #31283
